messages:
Maya H: Quick async check-in from me — what I did / blockers / today

• Did: finished first pass of the new sample flow for the Java SDK (sampleflow-java). Added a tiny README + usage snippet.
• Blocker: CI flaky on macos-latest for the sample app — failing at native build step (arm64 binary).
• Today: triage CI, land docs update for quickstart, pair with @Ben P on packaging.

Ben P: thanks — I can pair later today (EST 11:30). For the mac failure: seeing this in the log: `ld: library not found for -lssl` — might be an openssl path issue on the runner.

Clara R: re: README — can you add a note about `REDWOOD_API_KEY` + required env var for local runs? Saved me a few minutes yesterday. Also pinging @Diego S for a quick review of the Java snippet.

Diego S: will review after lunch. Quick FYI — the sampleflow-java uses the streaming client; I noticed we call `client.stream()` without closing the stream on error. I'll add a small try-with-resources patch.

Eve L: small doc fix — the quickstart page still references the old `redwood_client` name. I'll open a tiny PR and tag docs owners. Also can we add a one-line troubleshooting section for that macos link error? Many folks hit it on CI occasionally.

Maya H: @Eve yes please. For the troubleshooting note, suggest this snippet:```bash
# install openssl dev on macos runners
brew install openssl@3
export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/include"
```
That worked locally for me.

Ben P: that patch + env note should fix CI 90% of the time. I'll try to reproduce in a local macos container. If we still see flakiness, we can switch the CI job to use images with preinstalled deps.

Clara R: tiny reminder — if we change CI base images, add a one-line callout in the devex quickstarts so new contributors know what to expect.

doc-bot: New PR opened by @Eve L: docs/quickstarts/java-sampleflow: fix client name + add troubleshooting (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482) :white_check_mark:

Diego S: Reviewed the Java try-with-resources change, left a small comment about closing the `kvCache`. Otherwise LGTM.

Maya H: thanks everyone. Plan for today: pair with @Ben P at 11:30, land the docs PR once green, follow up with @Diego S review comments, and rerun the sampleapp e2e. If anyone wants to hop on debugging the mac runner, react with :mag: and I'll DM you the runner logs.

Ben P: :mag: I'll be there. Also fyi — I bumped the sampleflow-java version in the sample app to 0.3.0 in the branch so we can test the streaming fixes.

Clara R: :thumbsup: heading into a docs grooming session, will update contributor note afterwards.

Eve L: LGTM, will merge after CI green.

Maya H: closing the loop — leaving a short checklist here for follow-ups:
- merge PR (#482) after green
- Ben to confirm macos repro and propose CI change if needed
- Diego to push kvCache tweak and small test
- Clara to add contributor note to quickstarts
- I'll run the e2e sampleflow job and report any failures in this thread

Maya H: end
